canonical_project: Raxio prospective Bouake data center site
notes: At Raxio's Grand-Bassam CIV1 launch coverage, the Ivorian digital minister was reported as promising Raxio future sites including Bouake after VITIB, Yamoussoukro, Korhogo and San Pedro. This is treated as a planned/prospective expansion signal in Bouake, Bandama Valley; no capacity or schedule was disclosed.
